description: Guide the student to build a feature-engineering pipeline from OHLCV data (returns, rolling volatility, volume/technical features), then diagnose multicollinearity and look-ahead leakage risks.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I have OHLCV data and want to create useful features for a model. Where should I start and what mistakes should I avoid?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I need a systematic feature pipeline from OHLCV: multi-horizon returns, rolling volatility, indicators, and correlation checks.
student_openings.advanced_quant: I want a leakage-safe feature engineering pipeline with explicit shift discipline, collinearity diagnostics, and clear train/test boundaries.

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Tutor provides level-appropriate feature-engineering guidance with runnable examples, then validates feature quality via correlation/multicollinearity checks and explicit anti-leakage safeguards.
required_capabilities: Construct diverse OHLCV-derived features (returns, volatility, indicators)
Prevent look-ahead leakage in feature construction
Diagnose feature redundancy using correlation or VIF
